purpose: The second slice for docs/subsystems/actor-frame-parallel.md: where the character controller's update is called from inside an actor's movement, what the movement does with its result in the same turn, and what the Havok world's cast step 0x008DE950 writes - to decide whether controller casts of several actors can run at once. Map and refute only. Read knowledge/actor-frame-map.md first: it is the first slice's result.

functions.name: Caller of the character controller's update (name unknown)
functions.known: Measured: 39 of 63 sampler samples inside 0x00896000 return to 0x005E06A6 (run obng-profile-gate-guards/20261114-151935). 0x00896000 itself is only referenced from vtable slots 0x00A6FAE4, 0x00A752C4, 0x00A9689C.

functions.name: hkWorld cast / broad-phase step (proposal)
functions.known: knowledge/render-thread-outside-the-pass.md: checks the world's lock counters (+0x88/+0x8C, error 0x11), allocates two stack arrays from the thread's hkMemory stack (TLS +0x19C). Called from the phantom's cast 0x008ECC60 at 0x008ECCE6, from the integrate's tail 0x008ABAC0 and from the controller's update through 0x008ABA40 (knowledge/actor-frame-map.md). Its writes are known from pseudocode only.
